messages:
maria: Hey all — quick kickoff for the Serving Wins webinar next Tue. We need a compact design package for launch and post-webinar followups. Main asks below, first pass by Thu EOD if possible :pray:

maria: 1) 3 benchmark visuals (latency vs cost, throughput/GPU vs batch, cost/unit vs qps) — data-driven, annotated callouts.
2) 1 architecture diagram (routing & fallback: hosted -> dedicated -> private) that can be simplified into a social-friendly hero.
3) Slide template (16:9) + one-pager sales PDF with data callouts.
4) Social carousel: hero + 2 microtiles (sparkline + single stat). Mobile-first sizes.
5) Localization variants: en, fr, de.

maria: Figma starter file: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-wins-brief — use brand tokens and export frames as PNG/SVG. tagging: webinar_serving_wins. @ash can you own the benchmark graphs? @olivia brand QA, @jon lead routing + copy, @nate legal quick sweep.

ash: on it — will take the bench graphs. Need the raw CSVs and preferred chart style. Do we want stacked area for throughput or simple line + shaded CI? Also confirm palette: should I use the new bold palette or the muted palette for slides? :art:

maria: prefer bold for hero/tiles, muted for deep-dive slides. CSVs here: s3://redwood-marketing/bench/serving_wins/ (ping if you need access). Use annotated callouts for the two key wins: cost delta at 8k tokens and 95th pct latency.

ash: got access. quick spec block for exports — pls confirm:
```
bench-exports:
  hero: 1200x628 @2x (jpg)
  social-square: 1080x1080 (png)
  slide-chart: 1600x900 (svg)
  microtile: 540x540 (png)
```
Will mock by Wed.

olivia: brand notes — avoid using unapproved gradients on benchmark visuals; stick to token colors and iconography in /brand/assets. File naming + delivered layers must follow: marketing/serving-wins/{locale}/{asset_type}/{frame-name}. Also we prefer accessible color contrast — run a11y check. I can run the compliance pass Thurs. :white_check_mark:

nate: quick legal — careful with absolute claims like "cheaper than X" or naming competitors. Use phrasing: "observed cost reduction in our benchmark workloads" or "cost delta on representative workloads". Also flag any customer names if used.

jon: for inbound routing — once assets live, we need: 1) webinar landing hero (1200x628) + OG image, 2) 3 CTAs for nurture flow. HubSpot tag: webinar_serving_wins. Map suggested: source=webinar, campaign=serving-wins-q2, lead_owner=SDR_pool-webinar. Small config snippet for ops folks:
```
hubspot:
  campaign: serving-wins-q2
  tag: webinar_serving_wins
  funnel: webinar -> engaged -> mql
```
Also will write three short headline variants for the tiles — will drop copy in the figma file by Wed EOD.

designbot: FYI created a quick checklist in the figma file: "Assets -> Exports -> Locales" and added a folder for translations. Automation will export frames named per the brand rules on push.

maria: perfect — thanks everyone. Ash please prioritize hero + one benchmark this sprint so marketing can start the webinar page. Olivia + Nate, flag anything blocking by Thu morning. We'll sync Friday standup if needed. :rocket:
